critique: Flawless execution across all criteria. The upper dial features exactly 9 radial tick marks with a completely clean bottom arc. All 5 beach labels ('FRESHIE', 'QUEENSIE', 'LONG REEF', 'DEE WHY', 'CURL CURL') and the lower sub-dial ('NAH', 'YEAH', 'WORTH IT?') are spelled and positioned accurately. Each dial has a single burnt-orange pointer hand. The warm morning light on the terrazzo table with tortoiseshell sunglasses and a vintage zinc tube delivers top-tier editorial art direction.
